page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m4.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual workstation instance belonging to the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz. The host processor features 48 MB of L3 cache, 1 MB L2 cache per core, and hardware instruction extensions including AVX-512 with VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance is allocated 31.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is delivered via a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU slice (0.1667 of a full card) configured with 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance includes no local ephemeral storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for system and data disks. Network performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth profile of 3 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Benchmark measurements place the instance within the average mid-range tier across standard compute metrics, recording a Geekbench multi-core score of 8,775 and a PassMark CPU score of 16,850. In synthetic memory testing, it sustained uncached read bandwidth of 88.92 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 44.65 GB/sec. When executing AI workloads, small model (135M) inference generates 198.84 tokens per second, but performance drops into the lower quartile on medium (7B) parameter models at 8.13 tokens per second due to the 4 GB VRAM ceiling.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the fractional GPU configuration offers a cost-effective alternative to full GPU provisioning for lightweight visual processing and entry-level graphics workloads. However, the limited 4 GB VRAM buffer and the absence of onboard NVMe storage make it unsuitable for high-throughput database clusters or medium-to-large language model training. Primary workload targets include cloud virtual desktops, lightweight 3D rendering, remote CAD workstations, and low-parameter machine learning inference pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m4.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, paired with 31.0 GB of system memory and a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU slice offering 4 GB of VRAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor without bundled local storage, it utilizes network-attached disks and provides 3 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations place its compute and memory throughput in the middle 50% tier, achieving a multi-core Geekbench score of 8,775 alongside solid single-thread performance. The 4 GB VRAM limit delivers adequate throughput for small 135M models but exhibits constrained performance on 7B models. This instance is best matched for virtual workstation environments, entry-level graphics rendering, remote CAD usage, and lightweight machine learning inference.
